mechanism_of_action: Antioxidant activity; the abstract attributes reduced systemic inflammation mainly to increased circulating IL-10 in response to DNA damage recovery.
efficacy_outcome: After four months, IL-6 decreased and IL-10 increased significantly only with HXT+VitE; 4-HNE and 8-OHdG also decreased significantly in that group. IL-1beta and TNF-alpha decreased in both groups; no effect sizes or p-values are reported.
